scholarships.title: Valle d'Aosta Regional Right-to-Study Scholarships (VDA1 & VDA2)
scholarships.official_source: Regione Autonoma Valle d'Aosta - Istruzione e Diritto allo Studio
eligibility: Non-EU international students with valid residence permit
Enrolled in Bachelor's, Master's, or Single-cycle Master's at Valle d'Aosta institutions
Not holding degree of same/higher level
Not receiving other public scholarship for same year
benefits: Monetary grant (varies by ISEE band and status: in sede/pendolare/fuori sede)
Free accommodation in regional residences (if available)
Free daily meal(s) at university canteen
requirements: Valid ISEE Universitario or ISEE Parificato
Enrollment at eligible institution by deadline
Completion of online application on regional portal
documents: Property ownership docs 31 Dec 2025 (for ISEE Parificato)
scholarships.selection_notes: Ranking by ISEE (lower = better). Budget determines number of winners; eligible non-winners receive services only (meals, tuition exemption, tax refund) but no cash grant.
scholarships.english_requirement: Not required for DSU application; programme-dependent
application_method: Register on Regione Valle d'Aosta portal (SPID/CIE or temporary credentials for non-residents)
Check provisional ranking and submit appeals if needed
Provide Italian IBAN and PEC for payments
scholarships.best_fit: International students enrolling at Valle d'Aosta universities (UniVdA, Conservatoire, Nursing) who meet ISEE thresholds. Only OPEN regional DSU call as of Nov 2026.
scholarships.notes: Two tracks: VDA1 (standard DSU thresholds) and VDA2 (higher ISEE, no ISPE, no tuition coverage). Non-resident international students without SPID/CIE receive temporary credentials. International students classified as fuori sede unless family resides in Italy. First instalment ~Nov 2026; balance after merit verification Aug/Nov 2027.
scholarships.name: Valle d'Aosta Regional Right-to-Study Scholarships (VDA1 & VDA2)

scholarships.title: Politecnico di Torino PhD Scholarships — 42nd Cycle, 3rd Session
eligibility: Italian and foreign citizens (no nationality restrictions)
Master's degree or equivalent foreign qualification by 31 Oct 2026
Not holding another Italian PhD scholarship
Not a public employee on special leave with salary
Not a research fellow or holder of Art. 22-ter research position
benefits: 50% stipend increase for research periods abroad (up to 12 months, 18 for cotutelle)
Tuition fee waiver (regional tax €140/year still due)
Exempt from IRPEF and local income tax
documents: Declaration of Value / Diploma Supplement (foreign degrees)
scholarships.selection_notes: Minimum 110 funded positions across 3 sessions for 42nd cycle. Selection by programme committee. Reserved positions for foreign government scholarships, POLITO FOR REFUGEES, CONFLICT ZONES. Gross annual amount set by Ministerial Decree 247/2022.
scholarships.english_requirement: Required per programme (typically TOEFL iBT ≥90, IELTS ≥6.5, or equivalent); some programmes may accept Italian
application_method: Select PhD programme and session (3rd session: 14 Jan – 15 Feb 2027)
If selected: accept position and complete enrollment
Activate Italian residence permit (non-EU) within 8 days of arrival
Provide Italian IBAN for stipend payments
scholarships.best_fit: International PhD candidates in engineering, science, architecture, design, management. Fully funded 3-year position with research budget and abroad mobility. Application opens 14 Jan 2027.
scholarships.notes: 3rd session of 42nd cycle. Programme starts 1 June 2027. Part of minimum 110 funded positions across all sessions. Some programmes have inter-university agreements (Bioengineering with UniTo, Urban Development with UniTo, Electronics with INFN). Check programme tables for specific research topics and available positions.
eligible_programmes: Design and Technology. People, Environments and Systems

funding_details.conditions: Merit-based selection; annual renewal; 36 months max
funding_details.abroad_increase: 50% for up to 12 months (18 for cotutelle)

scholarships.name: Politecnico di Torino PhD Scholarships — 42nd Cycle, 3rd Session
